questions.cardDe: Welche Farbe hatte der erste verliehene Bambi?
questions.de: Welche Farbe hatte der erste verliehene Bambi?
questions.en: What colour was the first Bambi award ever presented?

timeline.labelEn: Karl Fritz's film-magazine readers' prize, from 1949 called the Bambi, is first awarded as a white ceramic fawn
timeline.labelDe: Der Filmpreis des Verlegers Karl Fritz, ab 1949 „Bambi“ genannt, wird erstmals als weißes Keramik-Rehkitz verliehen

questions.notes: The first award (1948, still nameless) was a white ceramic fawn by Else Bach from the Majolika-Manufaktur Karlsruhe; gilded bronze only from 1958.

questions.cardDe: Was bedeutete im alten Rom das Wort „Margarita“: Krafttrunk, Sonnenschein oder Perle?
questions.de: Was bedeutete im alten Rom das Wort „Margarita“?
questions.en: What did the word "margarita" mean in ancient Rome?

timeline.labelEn: Classical Latin, in which margarita (borrowed from Greek margarites) means "pearl"
timeline.labelDe: Klassisches Latein, in dem margarita (aus griechisch margarites) „Perle“ bedeutet

questions.notes: Card's multiple-choice answer was Perle. Latin margarita = pearl, from Greek μαργαρίτης; also the root of the name Margarete.

questions.en: Which horror author is so afraid of the number 13 that he will not stop reading on pages 94, 193 or 382, because their digits add up to 13?

timeline.labelEn: Stephen King, American horror novelist (born 1947 in Portland, Maine)
timeline.labelDe: Stephen King, US-amerikanischer Horrorautor (geboren 1947 in Portland, Maine)

questions.en: What does the German abbreviation GAU stand for?

timeline.labelEn: Early US nuclear-power era: the "maximum credible accident" design concept, rendered in German as GAU
timeline.labelDe: Frühzeit der Kernenergie in den USA: Konzept des „maximum credible accident“, auf Deutsch GAU

questions.notes: Literal English: 'largest accident to be assumed'; the concept goes back to the US 'maximum credible accident'. The decade is approximate (source: 'Frühzeit der Kernenergienutzung').

questions.en: How many pips does the domino on the Domino's Pizza logo have?

timeline.labelEn: DomiNick's is renamed Domino's Pizza; its domino logo gets three dots, one for each of the three stores
timeline.labelDe: DomiNick's wird in Domino's Pizza umbenannt; das Dominostein-Logo erhält drei Punkte – einen pro Filiale

questions.notes: The three dots stood for the three stores in 1965; the 2012 redesign kept them (two on the blue half, one on the red). The October 2025 logo was not checked.
